authored_metadata.use_guidance: Use this neutral ACM acmart two-column conference presentation as the default LaTeX stock. Marker composition replaces % ISOMER_BODY with the converted MyST body; fill the title, authors, abstract, and keywords from the MyST frontmatter and fill manifest before claiming build readiness. The nonacm option intentionally omits invented publication metadata.
